eval_data.text: We have a tax-calculator within a billing-software. A calculator always needs following inputs: netto price, sum of products and the location of the buyer and seller. It then calculates follwing outputs: tax per product, brutto price and tax-rate. It also outputs logging data for audits: calculated base price and rule of calculation.
eval_data.output:
features
    TaxCalculator {abstract}
        mandatory
            NettoPrice {abstract}
                alternative
                    FixedNettoPrice
                    CalculatedNettoPrice
            SumOfProducts {abstract}
                alternative
                    FixedSumOfProducts
                    CalculatedSumOfProducts
            BuyerLocation {abstract}
                alternative
                    DomesticBuyer
                    ForeignBuyer
            SellerLocation {abstract}
                alternative
                    DomesticSeller
                    ForeignSeller
        optional
            Discount

concepts
    CalculatedNettoPrice
        implies
            CalculatedSumOfProducts

    DomesticBuyer {abstract}
        implies
            DomesticSeller

    ForeignBuyer {abstract}
        implies
            ForeignSeller

    CalculatedBasePrice {abstract}

rules
    'TaxRateRule'
        if
            DomesticBuyer & ForeignSeller
        then
            TaxRate = 19%
        else
            TaxRate = 7%

    'CalculatedBasePriceRule'
        when
            CalculatedBasePrice
        then
            CalculatedBasePrice = NettoPrice + SumOfProducts - Discount

    'BruttoPriceRule'
        when
            CalculatedBasePrice
        then
            BruttoPrice = CalculatedBasePrice * (1 + TaxRate)

    'LoggingDataRule'
        when
            CalculatedBasePrice
        then
            LoggingData = "Calculated Base Price: " + CalculatedBasePrice + ", Rule of Calculation: " + TaxRateRule

eval_data.text: A CI/CD system defines deployment pipelines. All pipelines must run 'Build' and 'Unit Test' stages. A 'Staging' deployment is mandatory and can only run after 'Unit Test' passes. The 'Production' deployment requires the 'Staging' deployment to succeed, and also requires both 'Integration Test' and 'Security Scan' to pass. For 'Production', the user can select either a 'Blue/Green' or 'Canary' strategy. Choosing 'Canary' automatically adds a 'Monitoring' stage with a 'Rollback' trigger. Choosing 'Blue/Green' requires double the infrastructure resources during the swap. A separate 'Hotfix' pipeline can bypass 'Staging' and 'Integration Test', but requires a 'Manual QA Approval' step and must still pass the 'Security Scan'.

    "Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment System"
        mandatory
            "Deployment Pipelines" {abstract}
                mandatory
                    "Build Stage"
                    "Unit Test Stage"
                optional
                    "Staging Deployment" {
                        mandatory
                            "Passes Unit Tests"
                    }
                mandatory
                    "Production Deployment" {
                        mandatory
                            "Successful Staging Deployment",
                            "Passes Integration Test",
                            "Passes Security Scan"
                        alternative
                            "Blue/Green Strategy" {
                                mandatory
                                    "Double Infrastructure Resources During Swap"
                            }
                            "Canary Strategy" {
                                mandatory
                                    "Monitoring Stage" {abstract},
                                        mandatory
                                            "Rollback Trigger"
                            }
                        optional
                            "Bypasses Staging and Integration Test" {

Safety constraints are critical: the 'Smart Oven' action is disabled if 'Home Status' is 'Away'.
